subject: Can't set locale while publishing my app in shinyapps.io

messages.author: 5e4f8422e4de8543
messages.subject: Can't set locale while publishing my app in shinyapps.io
parts:
I tried to publish my app to shinyapps.io, but I keep getting an error: "Warning in Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "russian") : OS reports request to set locale to "russian" cannot be honored". That is why all my files are not read correctly and I get many errors: "Warning in grepl(pattern, text) : input string 1 is invalid in this locale" .

I have cyrillic letters in my data, how can I make my files download and be read correctly on shinyapps.io??

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Can't set locale while publishing my app in shinyapps.io
parts:
If you are trying to read a CSV file that is not encoded in UTF8, you
will have to specify the `fileEncoding` argument in read.csv(), e.g.
read.csv(fileEncoding = 'CP1251') (CP1251 is only my guess). See
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html for more info about
character encoding.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
